_about: Prep that has to start well before cooking. hours = how long before cooking starts (ideal range); max = the longest that is still fine; for sprouts, soak then sprout. fridgeMax/roomMax limit marinating time with and without a working fridge. water = ml of soaking water per g of dry beans. Cross-checked against each recipe's own method; quick-soak per the US Dry Bean Council and University of Minnesota Extension.

sources.title: University of Minnesota Extension: cooking dry beans (overnight and quick soak)
USDA FSIS: marinating meat safely and the 2-hour rule
FDA: raw kidney beans contain phytohaemagglutinin; boil thoroughly

moong-dal-chilla.note: For a breakfast chilla, soaking overnight is fine. Drain before grinding.

sprout-chaat.note: Soak, then drain and keep in a damp cotton cloth in a shaded spot; rinse morning and evening. Throw the batch away if it smells sour or feels slimy.

rajma-masala.note: Throw away the soaking water and pressure-cook until a bean mashes completely between two fingers: undercooked rajma causes severe stomach upset.
rajma-masala.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil the washed rajma in 4× its volume of water for 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain, then cook 2–3 whistles longer than usual.

rajma-minestrone.note: Drain and cook until a bean mashes completely.
rajma-minestrone.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil the washed rajma in plenty of water for 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain and cook a few whistles longer.

rajma-burrito-bowl.note: Drain and cook until a bean mashes completely.
rajma-burrito-bowl.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil the washed rajma in plenty of water for 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain and cook a few whistles longer.

chole.note: Drain, rinse and cook in fresh water.
chole.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil the washed chana in plenty of water for 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain, then cook 3–4 whistles longer.

hummus.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain and cook until very soft.

air-fryer-falafel.note: Falafel needs raw soaked chana: never quick-soaked, boiled or canned, or the balls fall apart. Without a fridge, change the water every 8 hours.
air-fryer-falafel.noQuick: No shortcut: swap this dish if you haven't soaked the chana.

dried-green-peas-masala.note: Drain and smell them before cooking: sour or slimy means throw them away.

green-peas-usli.note: Cook until just soft (2–3 whistles) and drain well.

kala-chana-masala.quick: Forgot? Quick-soak: boil 3 minutes, cover off the heat for 1 hour, drain and cook 2–3 whistles longer.

alasande-saaru.quick: Forgot? Alasande cook from dry in about 5–6 whistles on medium; keep an eye on the water.

hurali-saaru.note: Pick out stones first. Soaking 2 hours or more shortens the cooking.
hurali-saaru.quick: Forgot? It still cooks unsoaked: add 2–3 more whistles.

matki-usal.note: Soak, drain, then keep covered in a damp cloth; rinse once a day. Ready when most have short tails. Throw away if sour or slimy.

misal.note: Soak, drain, then keep covered in a damp cloth; rinse once a day. Ready when most have short tails.

hesarukalu-usli.quick: Forgot? Unsoaked moong cooks in 3–4 whistles; drain well.

neer-dosa.note: Soaking overnight is fine; drain before grinding.

pesarattu.what: whole green moong and the 2 tbsp rice
pesarattu.note: Soak the rice with the moong. Overnight is fine for a breakfast pesarattu.

sabudana-khichdi.note: Rinse 3–4 times, then add water only just level with the pearls (no more) and cover. Pearls should press flat between two fingers; if hard at the centre, sprinkle 2 tbsp water and wait 30 minutes.
sabudana-khichdi.noQuick: No shortcut: under-soaked sabudana stays hard and over-wet goes sticky. Swap the dish if you didn't soak it.

butter-chicken.note: With a fridge, marinating overnight gives more flavour.

air-fryer-tandoori-chicken.note: The recipe chills the marinade; without a fridge keep it in the coolest covered spot and cook within the hour.

mutton-curry.note: The raw papaya paste tenderises fast: don't go past 2 hours even in the fridge, or the meat turns mushy.

mutton-biryani.note: Never more than 2 hours: papaya makes the meat mushy.

air-fryer-chicken-65.note: Add the cornflour and rice flour just before air-frying.

atta-bhatura.note: Knead with the curd and lukewarm water, cover and keep in a warm spot.

curd.note: Warm the milk until it feels just warm on a finger (about 40 °C), stir in 1 tsp curd per 250 ml, cover and leave in a warm spot. Bengaluru nights may need 8–10 hours.
